name: Orca — Mention AI Anywhere
description: Mention @orca in any comment box for instant AI replies. Side-panel chat about any page. One-click image edits.

externally_connectable.//: Allows the orca-web frontend to call chrome.runtime.sendMessage(EXT_ID, ...) for the post-login JWT handshake + Stripe-success subscription refresh. Real domain is pingorca.com; the vercel.app subdomain stays whitelisted so historical bookmarks still work end-to-end.

content_scripts.//: Bridges background → page-world events on pingorca.com tabs so the web app can mirror extension auth state (e.g. force sign-out). Document_start so the listener is wired before the page's first paint.

Image-hover quick-edit affordance. Universal scope — runs on <all_urls> so any image on any site shows the trigger button. detectPlatform() in orca-image-hover.js returns a platform key for known CDNs (Twitter / IG / FB / Weibo / Xiaohongshu / Pinterest / Google) so bestUrlForImg can upgrade to higher-res variants, and returns 'default' otherwise (button still works, just uses img.currentSrc as-is). Per-platform gating (Facebook photo detail / Google image search) is in isQualifyingImg, not in manifest matches. Loads its own CSS (all classes prefixed orca-img-hover-* to avoid collision with the host page or other Orca content scripts).
